prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1168; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main entrance when the other car hit my rear driver's side.
Q: Were you moving or stopped when the impact occurred?
A: I had just started rolling backward out of the space. I'd checked my mirrors, but I didn't see the other vehicle coming down the aisle.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were going?
A: Maybe two or three miles an hour. It was a very slow parking lot speed.
Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?
A: Yes, we swapped insurance cards and phone numbers. He said he was looking at his phone for a second.
Q: Were you hurt at the scene?
A: Not right away. I felt fine standing there, but by the next morning my neck was stiff and my lower back was sore, mostly on the left side.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I saw my family doctor and then a physical therapist. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and I've been doing exercises a few times a week.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes, my neck still hurts when I turn my head to the right, and I have trouble sitting for long periods. Some days are better than others.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled properly. Thank you for your time.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
